name: Nai Harn
seoTitle: Nai Harn, Phuket: Area Guide, Property & Rentals
seoDescription: Nai Harn, Phuket: one of the island's best swimming beaches, a lake and a strong long-stay community. Area guide, projects, rents, FAQ and yield calculator.
intro: Nai Harn is a small bay at the southern tip of Phuket, next to Rawai, with one of the island's most attractive swimming beaches and a lake surrounded by a walking and running track. It has a strong community of long-stay residents and a slower, outdoor lifestyle.
overview:
Nai Harn sits between Rawai and Promthep Cape at the southern end of the island. The beach is backed by hills and the lake, so development is mostly set back on the surrounding streets rather than on the sand.
Our catalogue lists condominium and villa projects here, including Wallaya Residence Nai Harn, The One Naiharn and Sunny Moon Village; Rawai's shops, markets and the international schools of the south are a short drive away.
suitableFor: Active people who like swimming, running and yoga
Buyers who want a beach close to home
highlights: Nai Harn Beach, calm and clear in the dry season
Nai Harn lake with a walking and running track
Cafes, yoga studios and gyms around the lake
Ya Nui, Promthep Cape and Rawai within minutes

lifestyle: Life in Nai Harn is relaxed and outdoors: morning swims, walks or runs around the lake, yoga and cafes. Restaurants and bars are small and local; for supermarkets, hospitals and bigger shops residents drive to Rawai and Chalong.
beaches: Nai Harn Beach is a sheltered bay with soft sand that is calm for swimming from about November to April; from May to October waves can be strong and red flags are common. Ya Nui Beach and the viewpoint at Promthep Cape are a few minutes away.
rentalMarket: Nai Harn has steady long-term rental demand from long-stay residents, families and remote workers, and good holiday demand in the dry season because of the beach. Well-located condos and villas near the beach and lake tend to let quickly.

rentalDetails.title: Long-term rentals
rentalDetails.text: Long-stay residents, families and remote workers look for condos and villas within a short ride of the beach and lake.

rentalDetails.title: Short-term holiday rentals
rentalDetails.text: Strongest from about November to April; properties close to the beach are easiest to let.

rentalDetails.title: Suitable property types
rentalDetails.text: One- and two-bedroom condos; pool villas for families.

rentalDetails.title: Advantages and limitations
rentalDetails.text: Advantage: beach and lake lifestyle with year-round residents. Limitations: limited land near the beach, about an hour to the airport, and quieter low season for holiday rentals.

investment: Buyers choose Nai Harn mainly for lifestyle, often combining own use with long-term letting. Supply close to the beach is limited, so location within Nai Harn matters more than in larger areas.

investmentDetails.title: Typical investor profiles
investmentDetails.text: Owner-occupiers who rent out while away; buyers of condos for long-term tenants.

investmentDetails.title: Risks to consider
investmentDetails.text: New condos competing for the same tenants; check the walking distance to the beach claimed by projects.

investmentDetails.title: Ownership costs
investmentDetails.text: Common fees and sinking fund, management commission, maintenance and insurance.

faq.question: Is Nai Harn Beach good for swimming?
faq.answer: Yes, from about November to April Nai Harn is one of Phuket's best swimming beaches. From May to October waves and currents can be dangerous, so follow the flags.

faq.question: What is the difference between Nai Harn and Rawai?
faq.answer: They are neighbours: Nai Harn is the swimming beach and lake, Rawai is the fishing bay with the pier and seafood market and most of the shops. See our Rawai vs Nai Harn guide.

faq.question: Is Nai Harn good for families?
faq.answer: Yes, many families live in and around Nai Harn because of the beach, the lake park and the international schools in the south of the island.

faq.question: Can foreigners buy property in Nai Harn?
faq.answer: Yes, within Thai rules: foreigners can own condominium units freehold within a building's 49% foreign quota, while villas and land are usually bought on a registered lease. Check the title of each unit with a lawyer before buying.

faq.question: How far is Nai Harn from the airport?
faq.answer: Nai Harn is at the southern end of the island, roughly an hour from Phuket International Airport by car, depending on traffic.
